question: To which form of Tārā is homage paid in the Mahācīna practice?
premises: Tārā is associated with the Mahācīna practice
Tārā saves across the three realms
inference: One bows to Tārā of the Mahācīna practice, the savior across the three realms
plain_english: Having bowed to Tārā of the Mahācīna practice, the savior across the three worlds.
